## Prerequisites

1. Follow the instructions in the ValidMind release notes repository README.

2. Ensure you've met all the [Access requirements](access-requirements.qmd).

3. Make sure you understand how release notes are structured:

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## How are release notes structured?

Release notes are are published by [`documentation`](https://github.com/validmind/documentation) builds in two places:

| Surface | URL | Audience | Lists |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Public releases hub** | [All releases](https://docs.validmind.ai/releases/all-releases.html) | Product discovery, library, docs changelog | Curated highlights & invididual PRs, ValidMind Library releases, documentation updates but *not* CMVM assembled release-lists or patch notes |
| **Installation / Customer-managed ValidMind** | (CMVM) Release notes | On-prem CMVM installers | Every `releases/cmvm/**/*.qmd` assembled release-lists — monthly and each patch |

#### How are release notes embedded?

- Partials hold release narratives and are inserted into wrappers or the assembled release-list pages
- Wrappers or assembled release-list pages display content on Quarto listings

##### File patterns

- *Assembled release-list pages* are full narrative pages listed on the CMVM installation grid. Monthly pages use `{{< include >}}` partials, and patch pages include inline bug/support notes only.
- *Wrappers* supply listing-table metadata (`title`, `subtitle`, `.hidden`, `categories`) and use `{{< include >}}` partials — they never appear on the CMVM grid.

| Pattern | Partial / Wrapper | CMVM assembly | Public `/releases/` listing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `releases/cmvm/**/release-notes.qmd` | Wrapper | This *is* the assembled CMVM release-list page | **No** |
| `_pr-*-highlights.qmd` (content partial) | Partial | **Yes** — via `{{< include >}}` onto the assembled release-list | No |
| `pr-*-highlights.qmd` (listing wrapper) | Wrapper | No | **Yes** — Curated feature highlights |
| `_pr-{n}.qmd` (bug content) | Partial | **Yes** when support-associated | No |
| `pr-{n}.qmd` (bug wrapper) | Wrapper | No | **Yes** — Under ValidMind Platform releases when PR is tagged as `support` (label/category) |

> [!NOTE]
> **CMVM conditional titles**
>
> During generation of patch and monthly release partials, the initial draft adds a conditional` :::: {.content-visible when-meta="includes.cmvm"}` wrapper around the title for any non-library repo PR:
> - This wrapper ensures that the title is not duplicated when partials are inserted into public release wrappers.
> - However, when these partials are included in the CMVM release-notes.qmd wrappers, these titles will display above the content as the CMVM release notes wrapper does not include titles within the file.

##### Quarto listings

Quarto listings retreive and display links to other pages that match a defined query in a table (sometimes displayed as grid tiles) — in the case of release notes, wrappers that match a specific category of releases.

###### CMVM installation

| Listing page | Source `.qmd` | Lists |
| --- | --- | --- |
| (CMVM) Release notes | `installation/site/installation/release-notes.qmd` | Grid of assembled `releases/cmvm/**/release-notes.qmd` pages — monthly (`YY.MM`) and patch (`YY.MM.NN`) |

###### Public releases

| Listing page | Source `.qmd` | Lists |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [All releases](https://docs.validmind.ai/releases/all-releases.html) | `documentation/site/releases/all-releases.qmd` | Hub grid linking to platform, library, and documentation sub-pages; embedded highlights table of `pr-*-highlights.qmd` wrappers |
| [Feature highlights](https://docs.validmind.ai/releases/feature-highlights.html) | `releases/feature-highlights.qmd` | Curated `pr-*-highlights.qmd` wrappers (`categories: highlight`) |
| [ValidMind Platform releases](https://docs.validmind.ai/releases/validmind-platform-releases.html) | `releases/validmind-platform-releases.qmd` | `releases/frontend/**/pr*.qmd` wrappers |
| [ValidMind Library releases](https://docs.validmind.ai/releases/validmind-library-releases.html) | `releases/validmind-library-releases.qmd` | `releases/validmind-library/**/pr*.qmd` wrappers |
| [Documentation updates](https://docs.validmind.ai/releases/documentation-updates.html) | `releases/documentation-updates.qmd` | `pr*.qmd` wrappers tagged `documentation` |
| [Breaking changes and deprecations](https://docs.validmind.ai/releases/breaking-changes-and-deprecations.html) | `releases/breaking-changes-and-deprecations.qmd` | Platform, backend, and library wrappers with breaking-change or deprecation categories |

##### Internal releases portal

The `release-notes` repo also renders its own internal [Release notes portal](https://cautious-carnival-ggrg7r1.pages.github.io/) with additional listing pages not copied to public releases: 

- [CMVM releases](https://cautious-carnival-ggrg7r1.pages.github.io/releases/cmvm-releases.html) (`releases/cmvm-releases.qmd`) 
- [Backend releases](https://cautious-carnival-ggrg7r1.pages.github.io/releases/backend-releases.html) (`releases/backend-releases.qmd`, includes `releases-internal/backend/**/pr*.qmd`)

:::
